tests.sequence: Eleven initial integration tests and 44 broad tests passed. Inspection found that an empty history file could be treated as absent. Added rejection in capture/sidecar codec, preserving encoded absent-history representation; all 11 affected integration tests then passed. Final CLI/child exit0 and image match final source.
tests.symlink_platform_note: Symlink creation/rejection actually ran locally and result is true. Platforms unable to create the synthetic symlink report symlink_checked:false; no pass is invented for that subcase.

implementation.slots: Exactly the base path and fixed .city/.city.history siblings; no arbitrary source slots or embedded filenames. Require caller-owned trusted parent directory. No legacy source file replacement.
implementation.capture: Require caller-held shared monitor and nonnegative monotonic source revision before file reads. Read regular files with NOFOLLOW, size from the same opened channel and at most 64 KiB per read, checking cancellation and truncation/growth. Enforce 16 MiB base plus 4 MiB combined sidecars. Orphan and empty history files reject. Copy bytes and recheck exact bytes/absence plus source revision before returning snapshot.
implementation.staging: Detached parsing and private generation force may run outside source monitor. Snapshot does not expose source arrays. Publication requires the same monitor, unchanged source revision and exact source bytes/absence before existing private generation commit. Competing destination generation fences remain in force.
implementation.contract: Every source writer must share the caller monitor/revision. This is not exclusion of arbitrary external processes. Unsaved in-memory edits are fenced only when their owner advances the supplied revision. Source copying/revalidation remains synchronous and unqualified for the game-thread budget.

Expected preservation and source/destination fencing; observed passed with 25 rejection cases. Source files stayed unchanged by migration. Fresh actual child exit0/result captured and visually inspected. Browser/game playtesting does not apply to tools-only migration code. All 224 native workflow source hashes remain unchanged.

limitations: Not connected to LocalGame/server ownership or production save discovery. Cooperative monitor/revision excludes only participating writers; trusted parent directories and caller ownership are required. No arbitrary external-writer or multi-file atomic snapshot guarantee. No coordinated legacy-file replacement, server-player migration, persistent undo or ordinary-edit integration. Sidecar bodies remain opaque; no semantic city validation. Existing private generation post-rename recovery behavior applies; no universal rollback/power-loss claim. No peak-memory or 100 ms owner-thread qualification.
